description: Look up a single app by its store ID. Returns app metadata including name, developer, category, rating, reviews, installs (Android), and price. Works without an API key (free tier, limited daily use per IP). If the store is throttling, the result may be Sonar's stored copy: it then comes back as `{ data, meta }` with `meta.stale: true`, its date in `meta.stale_as_of`, and a `meta.note` to pass on to the user.

country.description: Market as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "us", "gb", "de", "mt"). Any App Store storefront (175 countries) or Google Play market (145). Default "us".

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

store_id.description: Store-specific app identifier. iOS: numeric track ID (e.g. "123456789"). Android: package name (e.g. "com.spotify.music").

name: sonar_app_lookup
title: Look Up App
